notes.title: The DUPLICATOR patch 2.3.0
notes.content:
Patch 2.3.0
-NEW ABILITY: The DUPLICATOR (I had to do a lot of work to have this thing not be totally OP. I think it's in a good spot now. Should be a powerful support ability)

-Redesigned most moon levels and added some new ones. Including a new platform type. (I thought the space levels were a bit dull with only circular platforms. A lot of them also had platforms that were very high up, which paired poorly with the high jump height in space)

-Playing online is now much more stable when there are laggy players. (hopefully only mod-caused desyncs remain now. fingers crossed)
-Mods will now auto-disable the matchmaking button to avoid desyncs in online play

-Going all random is now more likely to give you at least 1 offensive ability (the last ability is rerolled once if you ended up with none.)

-Eating a player now increases your size slightly

-Fixed a common bug where loading a new level would show all the platforms before they were animated in

-Fixed a bug with the rotation-physics of platforms with things attached to them, This primarily means rocket engine rotates things a lot more now.

-Fixed a bug where your numberOfAbilities setting got messed up after playing online

-Slimes of the same color (clones) can now hurt each other using beam, rock, drill and meteor

-Picked up boulders will no longer flip to their mirror image as they are picked up

-Missile explosions no longer teleport down when hitting the top blast-zone

-You can now load the next replay in your replay folder by clicking "next game" in the endgame screen, after you have watched a replay. clicking f10 will skip to the next replay immediately and holding f9 will speed it

notes.title: Patch 2.2.3 Balance changes
notes.content:
Patch 2.2.3 Balance changes

[b]Beam NERFS[/b]
[list]
[*]    turn speed 25 -> 20
[*]    Beam grounded startup time 1s -> 1.2s
[*]     Hookshotting an aerially beaming player no longer applies gravity to them
[/list]
[b]Blink gun now teleports players to a random position when hit.[/b]
[list]
[*]     You will not get teleported into the water or too far away from your current position.
[*]     If you are teleported when on a platform, you will end up on a platform.
[*]     If you are teleported in the air, you will end up in the air.
[*]     Blink gun CD 2.5s -> 5s when hitting a player
[/list]
[b]Players no longer keep their momentum when teleporting[/b]

[b]Teleport[/b]
[list]
[*]     The second cast of teleport now has no cooldown
[*]     cooldown 2.5s->3s
[*]     Teleport now works on blackholes
[/list]
[b]Missile BUFFS (It was a bit too easy to get away from missiles)[/b]
[list]
[*]     cooldown 4s -> 4.5s
[*]     speed 15 -> 18
[*]     turn speed 2.2 -> 2.5
[*]     let-go force 800 -> 1000
[/list]
[b]Smoke bomb BUFFS[/b]
[list]
[*]     Throw force 135 -> 160
[/list]
[b]Grenade BUFFS[/b]
[list]
[*]     Throw force 135 -> 160
[/list]
[b]Growth/shrink ray[/b]
[list]
[*]     Everything except players and large platforms are now resized more 0.8 -> 1.4 per hit
[*]     shrink ray no longer has a bigger effect on black holes than growth ray
[/list]
[b]Time stop[/b]
[list]
[*]     cooldown 8s -> 3s
[*]     timestop cooldown is now frozen during timestop
[/list]
[b]Ability spawns now spawn less often. Spawn time 25s -> 40s[/b]

notes.title: Patch 2.2.0 MATCHMAKING & NEW ABILITY!!
notes.content:
Patch 2.2.0 ONLINE MATCHMAKING & NEW ABILITY
-Added online matchmaking:
  There is now a <find players> button in online lobbies
  Note that there is no ranked-mode, since dividing the queue times further
  is probably a bad idea.
  You can play locally, or move around in the settings while queuing, but you can't play online without exiting the queue.
  This will be available for demo players as well (although they will not be matched against players with the full game)!
  The feature is still not thoroughly tested, so let me know if it works well
  and if the queue times are OK.
  Also let me know if the translation became weird in any language!

-New ABILITY: BEAM
-Enlarged platforms will now return to their original size after 10s (and during sudden death). The idea is to have fewer situations where the players get stuck and can't get to each other.
(does not apply to shrunk platforms, or enlarged non-platforms)
-edited some levels slightly
-You no longer spawn inside a big asteroid on a particular map
-Many slimes jumping around at once should now sound better
-various online lobby fixes
-Everyone is no longer disconnected when someone leaves or is kicked.
  It can still happen, but only due to connection errors mid-game
-Game will now disconnect you from lobbies that are on a different version to avoid desyncs

notes.title: Patch 2.1.0 Features, balance changes and bug fixes
notes.content:
Patch 2.1.0 New features, balance changed and bug fixes!
You may have to restart steam to get it to update!
Make sure you aren't playing with someone on 2.0.XX because it will lead to issues!

Slimes can now eat other slimes if they are much larger (relatively)
-Revive nerfs:
    Respawn particle speed 40 -> 30
    Revive point is now always forced into level bounds
    A respawning player can now be attacked during the spawn animation
-Invisible players can now see themselves when playing online.
-Invisibility duration 10s -> 5s.
-Smoke is now a smoke grenade, thrown in the same way as a normal grenade.
-Smoke clouds per grenade 3 -> 4
-activated engines now detonates smoke
-You can now place up to 4 engines without removing the previous one (letting you place several engines during timestop)
-Drill can now correctly be gusted

-Fixed a bug when dying far away from your revive point, resulting in various types of weirdness, including hovering unkillable players.
-blink gunning a player will no longer move them inside of a platform
-Players will no longer sometimes fall through a platform if they are inside of it
-Spiking on a platform that was just destroyed, will no longer lead to an error ending the round.
-Throw now counts as an offensive ability (for achievements)
-The "Noice" achievement will no longer be granted to everyone in the online lobby
-Surviving for a long time on orbital maps, will no longer lead to platforms teleporting around.
-Mines will now arm during time stop, for the player who did the time stop (though they won't chase)
-growth/shrink ray should no longer continue during timestop
(considered keeping this bug in the game, but there were some situations where it negatively affected the game)
-Lowered the mass of some small platforms that were way too heavy
-You can no longer get achievements by watching replays
-Added 2 new achievements

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 for the demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the first patch for the demo!
Note that you need to have the same version of the demo to play with eachother properly (there may be issues if someone is on the old version in an online lobby)

-Blink gun now gets progressively less duration on players, the more times they are hit. (so that they cannot be permanently held in place)
-Dash now preserves less momentum on space levels. (2 dashes should no longer be enough to fly in space)
-Game background and menus should no longer look bad on an ultra-widescreen monitor (at least up to 3440x1440)
-Added a link to the discord in main menu
